decisions.reason: The reset button and additional controls do not change the independently specified PIR connector.
The panel controls do not change the addressable LED power, level shifting, or shutdown behavior.
The source concerns reset and button controls, not the sensor board's role as a connector hub.
The source does not alter the separate eight-LED array board.
The mentioned switch and buttons do not necessarily modify the software-switched 5V rail or any of its current attributes.
The panel reset control does not change the interboard power connector type, pin count, or matching rule.
No change to the interboard signal connector or its pinout is entailed by the control inventory.
The source identifies additional controls but assigns no GPIOs and therefore does not change the current GPIO mapping.
The existing architecture already places system connectors on the main board; identifying a reset button and other controls does not necessarily change the board architecture or roles.
The reset button and other controls do not affect the power board's TVS ESD protection requirement.
The source does not change I2C cabling, pull-ups, bus speed, or series-resistor policy.
The panel controls do not change the native USB data interface.
